QuestInfo.name: Guardian of the Sea
QuestInfo.0: You've beat up the Lorangs, Clangs, and Torties who live on Florina Beach. Beating up the wildlife is what being a Pirate is all about!
QuestInfo.1: There's a giant monster on Florina Beach! You only have two choices: beat it because it's a threat to the Nautilus, OR beat it because you wanna!
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the #b#o5220000##k. You are one bad Pirate! The seven seas have never seen the likes of you before!

0.0: Fantastic work, #h0#. Florina Beach is well on its way to becoming a world-class tourist trap! There's just...one little problem left...
0.1: Have you heard of #b#o5220000##k? It's a huge, mutated creature lurking on the other side of the island. No one goes there, because of how dangerous it is.
0.2: If you could just eliminate #b#o5220000#s#k, then Florina Beach will be completely safe! Children will be able to play and frolic without fear! What do you say?

yes.0: #b#o5220000##k is often seen in #r#m120030500##k. You might have even seen it while battling the Torties.

no.0: Please! Once you eliminate #b#o5220000#s#k, Florina Beach will be safe for everyone. Think of the children!

1.0: You did it, #h0#! You've saved Florina Beach!

yes.0: At long last... I can build that golf course I've always wanted. Thanks for clearing the land of monsters for me. Here's a little something to remember Florina Beach by. Enjoy!

mob.0: I know #b#o5220000##k must be tough... But we need this. The PEOPLE need this.
